deadline.value: Fall 2027 PhD deadline, 11:59 pm Eastern (Graduate School list).
deadline.quote: These are the application deadlines for applicants who wish to begin their graduate studies in fall 2027. | Chemistry 12/01/2026

funding.value: All admitted PhD students are guaranteed five years of funding, usually teaching and research assistantships.
funding.quote: All students admitted to the Ph.D. program are guaranteed funding for five years, usually through a combination of teaching and research assistantships.

entry_route.value: Applicants need an undergraduate degree in chemistry or a closely related field; no master's required.
entry_route.quote: The Department considers all applications from individuals with an undergraduate degree in chemistry or closely related field.

supervisor.value: Admitted to the program, not a research group; advisors are typically assigned at the end of the first semester.
supervisor.quote: Students are admitted into the Chemistry Ph.D. program and not directly into specific research groups. | Ph.D. advisors are typically assigned at the end of the first semester of the program

english_waiver.value: Department asks for TOEFL/IELTS from international students unless English is their first language or they studied at an institution where English is the language of instruction; the Graduate School's stricter two-year/country rule also applies, so confirm with the department.
english_waiver.quote: All international students not having English as a first language, or who have not studied at an institution where English is the language of instruction, must submit an official TOEFL or IELTS score.
